scope: resolve the complete REHT clearance chain into a signed non-authority-expanding RACSDecision and bind it into CoreExecutionPermit and CommitToken
dependencies: verified clearance-to-permit binding merged in PR #95
atomic CommitToken consumption merged in PR #96
invariants: GovernanceClearance remains the sole positive authorization artifact produced by REHT
RACSDecision is binding evidence and never originates authority or directly permits execution
RACS must resolve ActionEnvelope, BoundaryCrossingAssessment, every GovernanceEvaluation and AdmissibilityDetermination before signing
RACS may preserve or narrow a REHT outcome but never expand it
REHT MODIFY constraints cannot be replaced without a machine-verifiable narrowing proof
CoreExecutionPermit requires the exact RACSDecision id and digest
CommitToken copies the exact RACSDecision id, digest and positive outcome
Core runtime enforcement implementation is not changed in this stage
